description: A .dtshd file with an ID3v1 tag whose title has five characters after its last chunk.

skip.ffprobe_bitrate: ffmpeg's lossless decoder sets the bit rate to 0 (dca_xll.c: avctx->bit_rate = 0), so ffprobe lists none
skip.ffprobe: ffmpeg's demuxer reads the tag as a chunk header and refuses its size (dtshddec.c: 'chunk size too small' or 'chunk size too big')
